objective: prepare a resumable five-GPU publication campaign bound to the verified quarantine child
acceptance_criteria: select any five stable idle physical GPUs without stopping unrelated work
preserve scientific job identity when physical GPU assignments change
run and validate a five-job one-epoch full-data pilot before research training
train the frozen 10-run Base/Small scale matrix
defer internal and external evaluation until both training matrices finish
record throughput, VRAM, GPU, CPU, RAM, configurations, manifests and result identities
support epoch-level restart and metadata synchronization to private Drive
non_goals: do not stop or preempt another user's GPU process
do not tune architecture or losses from held-out evaluation results
do not treat pilot outputs as research results
do not claim DDR evaluation or human duplicate adjudication
